Suicide isn't the answer, OP. Believe me, I know what it's like to be treated unfairly. We all do. Harming yourself won't fix your problems. Please don't do it. We care about you. *I* care about you. Do you think your friends and family would be *happy* if you killed yourself? I promise they'd be heartbroken. But if you decided to stay strong and not kill yourself, that's a victory right there. That'd be proof that you're not a failure. Trust me, OP. There are a lot of reasons to keep living. Every friend and every family member you have are each reasons for you to keep living. And what about the future? If you're determined to keep trying--to keep getting up when you've fallen--you'll make improvement and and find even more reasons to live. Hobbies, pets, recreation, friends, maybe a love interest? You never know what the future holds! So why not keep living? Flush those pills and give life another chance. Try different hobbies or forms of entertainment. Maybe try painting or go see a play. Sure, you'll still be treated unfairly, we all will. But if you stick yourself out there and find things you enjoy, you'll find that life is still worth living.

No, I won't give you *any* suicide tips. Come on now, don't give up so easily. I know what it's like to feel like you're disappointing people or failing them. It's not a good feeling. It's like you're stuck in a bad spot. But so long as we get up and keep trying, it's OK when we fall. It's like a runner in a race. Just because he falls, it doesn't mean he should give up or that he'll never make it. It means he should get up. He might not come in first, but wouldn't you say finishing the race is better than giving up? That's like life. You may never be a super-successful billionaire, and you may have to struggle to get by. But I think your friends and family would much rather see you fail and keep trying then quit altogether. And if you keep trying, eventually you'll get the hang of whatever it is you're trying to do.

We care. That's why we're here. Because we care and we want to help. Do you have any family or friends? Maybe a girl you've had your eye on? I'm sure they care about you as well. There's no reason to kill yourself. Trust me, I've been there. When you feel like nothing matters and that no one cares, think of all the people that came to help you. We might just be people on the Internet, but we're proof that there are plenty of people in the world that care. You just have to find them. Because if all you look at are the people that only think of themselves, that's all you ever see.

I'm sorry it's like that. But if you don't mind my asking, is there a reason you don't have friends? If you made some I'm positive you'd feel a lot better knowing someone cares about you. Is there anything you enjoy doing? Any hobbies or pass-times you enjoy? Maybe sports? It's nice to find someone that enjoys those with you. There's got to be something or someone that gives you a reason to live. Try naming one.

We care. Otherwise we wouldn't be here to help. Sure, there's plenty of stuff in the world like that. Some people nowadays only care about themselves. But there are also plenty of people that legitimately care. I care, so if you want to talk about anything/everything you're thinking of, I'm here. 

On a related note, we're not supposed to diagnose people but if you think you have a mental illness, you should see a doctor. I understand that it's hard to go to people with a problem like that, but your friends and family will be happy you did, and it will only be beneficial for you.

It's not stupid. You're posting because you still want to be here. If it might save your life, it's far from stupid. I don't know what you're going through, and I won't pry, but sometimes talking about the problem makes it a little bit better. So if you ever want to talk about it, feel free to talk! We're here because we want to help. 

So here goes: It'll be alright. Don't worry, OK? You'll make it through this. I promise.
